76707.synopsis:
Ji Yuebai, a genius in the cultivation world seen only once in a thousand years, was seriously injured during an outdoor training session when she encountered a little green snake.
She had always considered it her duty to eliminate demons and protect the Dao. Usually, she would dispatch these kinds of creatures with a single sword strike, but now, her severe injuries made it difficult to mobilize her spiritual energy. A slight misstep during her healing process could lead to demonic possession.
Helpless, Ji Yuebai could only watch as the jade-green little snake swam towards her across the water and wrapped itself around her body.
She made up her mind that as soon as her wounds healed a bit, she would cut this creature into a thousand pieces.
However, the little green snake, unaware of the impending disaster, flicked its pink tongue unconsciously. It just so happened to touch Ji Yuebai’s ears, as smooth and lustrous as pearls and jade, and suddenly found that the body beneath it started shaking uncontrollably.
It’s often said that snakes are naturally lustful, and demon snakes even more so. Ji Yuebai could no longer bear such a humiliation. What if she succumbed to demonic influences? She attempted to channel her spiritual energy into her sword, but at that moment, an icy sensation came from her wounds, providing temporary relief from the pain.
She then saw the green snake’s slender tail gently applying a sacred healing herb, which hadn’t touched water, to her wounds.
…
Ji Yuebai, the junior master from Tian Yuan Sect, who was always at odds with the demonic path, caused quite a stir in the sect when she returned from her training with a snake demon in tow.
Many people in the sect thought Ji Yuebai had lost her mind. Even more self-proclaimed warriors of justice, under the banner of demon-slaying and protecting the Dao, demanded the death of the little green snake, branding it a vile creature of evil.
That is, until Ji Yuebai stood on the Life and Death stage, shaking the fresh red blood from her sword, and said coldly: “Is there anyone else who objects? Let them speak on the stage of life and death.”
From that moment on, no one in the sect dared to bring up this matter again.
…
The little green snake followed Ji Yuebai in her daily cultivation. When Ji Yuebai got up, it did too; when Ji Yuebai rested, it would curl up into a ball in her arms and rest with her.
The unrivaled swordmaster of Tian Yuan Sect, Ji Yuebai, finally had a companion.
Many noticed that the Shishu, who used to have a stern face every day, now had much softer corners to her lips.
Until one day, Ji Yuebai woke up to a gentle, silky touch. She looked down to see an exquisitely beautiful woman with green snake skin softly curled up in her arms, her wrist resting on her waist in an almost boneless manner, and her voice was utterly captivating: “Yuebai, I’ve transformed~”
It was then that the always single-minded Ji Yuebai understood the true meaning of the term “demon.”
________________
Note from the author: The blurb is from the perspective of Ji Yuebai, and the main story itself is [mostly] from the perspective of the little green snake Xu Nian.

His father left to search for medicine to cure him. Little Ming Qiao sat on the doorstep, chewing on a steamed bun, waiting for his father. He waited and waited. But instead of his father, he witnessed a great battle between the Demon Lord and the Celestial Sect.

_______________

As he was carried around, Ming Qiao clung to the young Demon Lord’s neck. He made a promise and tried to brainwash him.
“Big brother, when I grow up, I’ll carry you too.”
_______________

On Ye You’s birthday, a tipsy encounter introduced her to a man. He had cool, chiseled features, a tall, lean figure, and lightly pressed pale lips that exuded a restrained yet magnetic allure.
It was as if he was performing on Ye You’s exact type of stage.
One day, Ye You’s mother asked her to visit Luming Hot Spring Resort to request a handwritten charm.
Upon arrival, she found the man from that night—the one she’d drunkenly started something with and then abandoned—sitting elegantly in the host’s chair.

97699.synopsis:
As a ginseng spirit on the verge of ascending to immortality, Lan Yun’er never expected to time travel! She wakes up in the world of a period novel, taking on the role of the most pitiful cannon fodder female side character.
In the original story, the character was the male lead’s wife, but she despised his poverty and refused to consummate their marriage. Later, the male lead rose to become a billionaire, while the female side character ended up homeless and destitute, dying tragically from illness.
When Lan Yun’er finds herself in this new life, she looks at her handsome and charming husband with shining eyes. She pounces on the male lead, exclaiming, “Hubby, give me a kiss!”
Huo Jincheng: “…”
After truly becoming husband and wife, Huo Jincheng’s health takes a miraculous turn for the better, becoming so strong that he can split stones with his bare hands. He is convinced that it’s all thanks to his wife’s influence and resolves to treat her with utmost care for the rest of his life.
One day, Huo Jincheng returns home to find his wife crouching by the stove, eating dirt. His heart aches as he scolds, “Wife, that’s dirt—you can’t eat that.”
The petite wife looks at him pitifully. “Husband, I’m hungry.”
On another day, Huo Jincheng finds her sitting in the most fertile rice field, drinking muddy water. His mouth twitches as he hurries to fish her out. “Wife, this water is muddy—you can’t drink that.”
She pouts, “I’m hungry.”
Huo Jincheng: “…”

98211.synopsis:
After 5 years as neighbors and 2 years as lovers, Yebon got dumped by his older boyfriend, who even slapped him and cursed at him. In his resentment, he took out his frustrations on a guy who was staring at him, but this guy… he’s definitely a gangster, a thug…!
“Hey.”
His voice seemed to smell of cigarettes. It was a rough, deep voice that crawled along the damp floor.
The man was so tall that Yebon had to crane his neck painfully just to meet his gaze.
“You shouldn’t say you’ll slap someone so carelessly.”
Yebon cautiously opened his tightly closed mouth to ask.
“…Why?”
The man, who cast a sidelong glance at Yebon, who was full of caution, placed his hand on his shoulder and leaned in close. The scent of heavy musk mixed with a sharp fragrance seemed to envelop Yebon’s neck.
“It would be a waste to just let this go.”
Expectantly.

100259.synopsis:
Our homeroom teacher has gone missing, and the police have come to the school to ask about it several times.
I’m really worried because our homeroom teacher has always been very kind to me.
I went home and told my mom about it. She smiled and said that good people have protection from the heavens.
I thought to myself, with such a good person as our teacher, surely nothing bad has happened to him.
The next day, I found our homeroom teacher in the basement of my house, tightly bound with ropes, his body covered in signs of ab*se.
I hadn’t even had the chance to figure out what exactly was going on when my mom came home.

102819.synopsis:
Lin Zheng transmigrated into a sweet and pampering romance novel, becoming the pitiful cannon fodder receiver—a character known for his taciturn nature, inability to speak his mind, frequent bullying, and ten years of unrequited love for the male protagonist (gong).
While the main couple follows a sweet and pampering storyline, his own path is a blatant tragic romance. According to the plot, he would date the male protagonist for a while, but after two months, upon the protagonist’s meeting with the main receiver (shou), he would be mercilessly abandoned, then ridiculed and driven away to live a miserable life alone.
He transmigrated right as he was in a relationship with the male protagonist.
—When people saw him holding flowers:
“They say he got these flowers after relentlessly pursuing Young Master Gu, who reluctantly bought them for him on the roadside.”
—When people saw him waiting for the bus alone:
“He must have angered Young Master Gu, who couldn’t stand him anymore.”
—When people saw him leaving the cinema alone:
“I heard that Young Master Gu is pursuing Young Master Wu’s son, probably tired of playing with him.”
However—
The flowers were a carefully chosen gift from Gu Lin, who took time off work to personally select them for Lin Zheng.
He was waiting for the bus alone because Gu Lin had upset Lin Zheng, and Lin Zheng refused to get into Gu Lin’s car, so Gu Lin followed him in his car the entire way.
He left the cinema alone because Lin Zheng said he was cold, and Gu Lin went back to the car to get him a coat. Unseen, Gu Lin held his lover’s hand, kissing him lovingly.
Everyone: “Wait, wasn’t this supposed to be a tragic romance?!”
—
Although Gu Lin treated him well, Lin Zheng noticed that while minor details might change, important plot points related to the main characters seemed unchangeable. He guessed that Gu Lin would still abandon him after two months upon meeting the main receiver.
So, Lin Zheng decided to abandon Gu Lin before he met the main receiver, packing his bags and running away.
That night, someone saw Lin Zheng leaving Gu’s mansion with a suitcase.
That person: “I told you, Young Master Gu was just playing with him. It’s not surprising he abandoned him now that he’s tired of him.”
A few days later, the same person saw Young Master Gu, his face weary, eyes bloodshot, giving orders: “Keep searching, even if we have to turn the earth upside down, we must find him!”
That person: “…Finished. This isn’t just playing around; he’s etched the person into his very bones!”
Free-spirited and lovable receiver vs. a ruthless boss who is only gentle with his wife.
#How a Ruthless Boss Dotes on his Free-Spirited Little Darling Who Keeps Ruining His Persona#
#I Treat You as My Lover, Yet You’re Planning to Leave Me#
Small Theater—
Lin Zheng: “Let’s break up; I don’t have feelings for you.”
Gu Lin: “No.”
Lin Zheng grabs the other person’s collar: “Will you break up or not!”
Gu Lin kisses the sulking lover’s mouth: “No.”
Sweet, refreshing, and heartwarming.
Lighthearted, silly, happy, and sweet; come eat candy!
associated_names: 不小心把虐文線走成了甜寵線[穿書]
不小心把虐文线走成了甜宠线

103075.synopsis: There’s a saying that a club is medicine for a mad dog. But what happens when the mad dog is the one wielding the club? And how did I, a son of an ordinary fruit vendor, somehow become one of these mad dogs?

103587.synopsis:
At his one command to stay still, the memory of freezing up and trembling like a mouse in front of a snake came back so vividly it was almost unpleasant. 
In front of Seoyoon, whose smooth face was slightly scrunched in humiliation from the sudden rush of shame, Kijung opened his mouth as if he couldn’t care less about his thoughts. 
“I have something I’d like to suggest to you today, Seoyoon.”
“……”
“Have you ever considered letting someone else handle that whip?” 
Silence followed.
Seoyoon couldn’t immediately respond. 
Before deciding whether he liked or disliked the suggestion, he couldn’t even understand what he meant by it.
As if had already anticipated Seoyoon’s blank reaction, Kijung continued.
“You said there are times when you want to feel pain, right?”
Seoyoon nodded.
There was still a contradiction in saying he wanted to feel pain, but since he couldn’t explain his own habit clearly, it wasn’t something he could argue against. 
What caught his attention was the man’s next words.
“I like causing pain.”

106147.synopsis:
While playing the online game “Convergence of Ten Thousand Realms,” Yan Luoyue suddenly found herself transmigrated into the body of a newly hatched baby turtle in the cultivation world of the turtle clan.
Fortunately, her system account had come along with her, and the skill books and equipment in her inventory were still intact.
However, there was a bug in her account information.
Year after year, Yan Luoyue watched as her health bar grew infinitely longer.
Every year on her birthday, an extra zero was added to her health bar.
In the first year after her transmigration, Yan Luoyue used all her divine artifacts to ensure her fragile self wouldn’t choke to death on her own saliva.
By the tenth year, she removed all her equipment and casually strolled through the forbidden grounds of her clan.
The sealed demons and monsters surrounded her, hacking away for three days and three nights, until they collapsed, foaming at the mouth.
A hundred years after her transmigration, Yan Luoyue looked up and realized her health bar now spanned the entire continent.
Someone once asked Demon Venerable Yan, “Does being invincible make you lonely?”
Yan Luoyue kindly replied, “Silly child, how could being invincible be lonely? It’s absolutely amazing.”
Synopsis Two:
Wu Manshuang was covered in poison, the last of the Teng Serpent (celestial serpent) lineage in the world.
The closer anyone got to him, the deeper the poison would affect them.
So, Wu Manshuang wrapped himself up tightly. He hid in a pitch-black cloak, avoiding all living beings. He thought his life would pass in solitude, until—
A young girl’s slender, warm hand touched his cheek.
“Your health-draining debuff is pretty strong, huh?”
Wu Manshuang quickly pushed her hand away. “Are you trying to get yourself killed?”
“Relax,” the girl said with a carefree smile. “I’m way stronger than you.”
From then on, the little serpent gently coiled around the turtle’s shell.
And then…
The world gained the divine beast Xuanwu.
Reading Tips:
1. This is my take on cultivation with personal world-building, possibly a lot of it.
2. A long, slow-burn progression story with a gradual narrative style.
3. A cultivation story with an ensemble cast.

108451.synopsis:
My wedding is next week, but my fiancé brought his ex-girlfriend, who also happens to be his first love.
I thought it had to be a dream.
I never imagined I’d see the two of them standing side by side again.
“I’m three months pregnant. I’d like to cancel the wedding and call off the engagement.”
With a face I’d never seen before—utterly unfamiliar—he coldly demanded to end things.
“We had to finish the engagement ceremony before her belly started to show.”
“There’s really no need to go through a ceremony at all, Carlisle,” the woman carrying his child said softly, smiling shyly beside him.
“I’ll send the annulment papers as soon as we return to the estate. You just need to sign them, Aileen.”
The arms that once held only me… now belonged to someone else.
And just like that, with a single sheet of paper, five years of time, everything between us—came to an end.
“Urgh…”
“What’s wrong? Are you hurt?”
If not for the look on his face—so unlike him, even after clashing swords—I might have believed I was truly ill.
“…Aileen, I’m so deeply sorry.. You were always the only one for me.”
Yes, if it weren’t for Carlisle, kneeling before me and pleading for forgiveness, that would have been the end of it all.

108707.synopsis:
A magical attempt to defeat my rival, Aska, failed miserably. It went in a completely unexpected direction.
“Are you a kidnapper? If you are, you picked the wrong person!”
“…Could it be that she is actually the younger me from when I was six?”
I didn’t just go back in time to when I was six years old—I actually summoned my six-year-old self! Changing the timeline is forbidden magic for wizards. If anyone finds out, I’ll be fired from the royal court, kicked out of the magic association, mocked by my rivals, and lose my mana core.
I tried to quickly send my younger self back to the right time before the side effects of forbidden magic, called “cracks,” took hold. But, of course, my rivals caught me.
“Who is this kid?” one of them asked.
“She, she’s my… my daughter!”
In an attempt to explain things quickly, my excuse turned into a huge misunderstanding, and my relationship with my rivals and enemies changed dramatically.
“Dad, try it.”
“Hey, kid, want a piggyback ride?” one of them said.
“I’ll give land to the daughter of the great one,” another one added.
Now, my rivals started acting like they were the fathers of my little self.

109219.synopsis:
“In spring, a single grain is sown; by autumn, ten thousand seeds are reaped.” 
[You’ve barely managed to plant a Tier-1 spirit plant, Emerald Bud Rice, using crude techniques. EXP +0.1!] 
[Emerald Bud Rice grows vigorously. You gain Emerald Bud Essence (1%)!] 
When Li Ye reluctantly accepted the sect’s spirit farmer task and planted his very first seedling, a path toward immortality unfolded before him. 
With a system panel to aid him, he received feedback from every plant. 
Talisman crafting, alchemy, artifact crafting, formations, gu techniques… 
“All these are merely meant to protect one’s path. If you truly want to become immortal plant trees.” 
Li Ye smiled calmly. 
Behind him, countless plants gathered in reverence. 
A towering tree pierced the heavens, connecting all realms its presence at the very center of existence. 
As its branches gently drooped, the Dao Fruit of the Green Emperor quietly took shape.
associated_names: Xianxia: I Cultivate the Dao by Planting Trees

109475.synopsis:
“Repay the sin of taking Natasha away from me, even with that wretched life.” 
The daughter of a fallen viscount family and a powerful Grand Duke of the North. 
It was happiness beyond her station. 
Helena’s life ended with false accusations of mu*dering Eugene’s mistress and the blade of the guillotine. 
But the regression repeated, and Helena loved him out of habit. 
So, worn down and exhausted, when she opened her eyes for the fourth time. 
“Let’s divorce.”
Finally, she bid farewell to him. And to her insignificant life. 
Helena sank her body into the deep sea, wishing only for complete death. 
But then. 
“You taught me. Desire is not a sin. If there’s something you want, take it.” 
Someone who ultimately saved her, who couldn’t even remain as a fragment of someone else,
“It’s not that I didn’t forget you, but that I couldn’t forget you. Because you are such a vivid person.”
She met a man who said she was his everything.
****
“There’s no way I would want anything from you.” 
It sounded like a gentle voice at first glance. 
That’s why Eugene found it difficult to digest. 
He wanted to run away instead. 
He had no strength left to endure. 
“When I left you at Evergale, back then.” 
“Helena. Please.” 
“We were already over. So please go back now.” 
With such a gentle voice, with such a tender face.
“Because I’ve completely erased you.” 
What should I do when you say goodbye.

109731.synopsis: Huai Yu, who remembers nothing, walks out of the forest to discover that six years have passed since a cataclysm devastated the world. Cities lie in ruins, and everything is in the process of rebuilding. And as for her? She’s been assigned six hundred mu of land and a handful of soybeans.
associated_names: Six Years After the Catastrophe, I Built a Farm by Sprouting Soybeans
灾后第六年，我靠发豆芽攒下农场

111523.synopsis:
“Is it strange to call me, a Clip YouTuber, a blue pill…?”
“Don’t mind me. Just watch the clips I uploaded and come to the live stream.”

112803.synopsis:
Chen Henian, born with a deathly countenance, is a great curse. He possesses the innate ability to see the sinister and the ghostly. At the age of six, he climbed the forbidden, ominous mountain, and since then, a great evil spirit has resided within him. With a Yin fate and being a reincarnated ghost himself, Chen Henian becomes a coveted “Tang Monk’s flesh” for ghost cultivators and evil entities.
However, Chen Henian, trained by a seasoned veteran, is not only adept at capturing ghosts but also harbors a powerful evil spirit within.
Chen Henian: Bark!
All Evil Spirits: Woof…
The beaten-up evil spirits: We’ve learned our lesson, please spare us.
Some fear him, while others fear the great ghost behind him.
Chen Henian: Can ghosts be afraid of other ghosts?
All Evil Spirits: Nonsense! That’s the Yin Ancestor!
Yin Ancestor extends a hand. Chen Henian: What an ugly claw.
Yin Ancestor pokes its head out. Chen Henian: What a powerful ghost.
Yin Ancestor forcibly hugs and touches him. Chen Henian: So, does it want to eat me or kill me?
What? It says it loves me.

119203.synopsis:
After Du Xiaoxiao was laid off by the company, she took a few thousand yuan in severance pay and returned to her hometown to run the family restaurant left by her grandfather.
On the first day of opening, she was tied to the state banquet system and asked to specialize in state banquet dishes.
98 for a portion of Dongpo pork,
668 for a portion of Wensi tofu,
 888 for a portion of boiled cabbage,
 and 1088 for a portion of canned three-treasure duck.
.Du Xiaoxiao immediately turned into a human-shaped Tyrannosaurus Rex: “You let a small restaurant sell state banquet dishes. You are really a fool.”
At first –
“Selling state banquet dishes in a small county town, let alone making it, you may have never seen it. Don’t be too ambitious.”
“Young people nowadays are really ignorant. State banquet dishes can’t be made by just anyone. Put aside the cooking skills, even the ingredients are hard to find.”
Later –
the richest man only chooses the state banquet restaurant for banquets.
When celebrities and celebrities gather, the first stop must be the state banquet restaurant.
 International super-rich people must take a special plane to the state banquet restaurant every month.
The state banquet restaurant has become a popular existence.
Later,
the once dilapidated building was transformed into a landmark building. The desolate backyard has a scene every five steps and a painting every ten steps, just like a paradise.
Du Xiaoxiao looked at the kingdom she had worked so hard to build and sighed: “At first I was really forced to do it, but now, it feels so good
 (＾-＾)V”
associated_names: 我有一棟國宴酒樓[美食]

119459.synopsis:
She thought her mother had abandoned her, but in truth, her mother had been protecting her all along.
In the end, her mother died while protecting her, beaten to death by the man she once called father, a true demon in disguise.
On the day Bella discovered the truth, she too lost her life at the hands of that same monster.
“Please, God, I beg you.”
She couldn’t let it end like this. With all her heart, she pleaded for just one more chance. She was willing to give up everything if only she could try again.
When Bella opened her eyes, she had returned to ten years ago, before any of the tragedy had begun.
“This time, I will protect Mother.”
She planned to take revenge on the father who had ruined everything and live a peaceful life with her mother.
But then, something unexpected happened.
“You promised you wouldn’t leave me, Bella.”
An invisible thread of fate began to wrap around her, pulling her into something she hadn’t foreseen.
“You promised, so you have to keep it.”
“Of course. Should we seal it with a pinky promise?”
“Here.”
She had meant it casually, but Edwin quickly reached out his pinky finger. That small gesture revealed how anxious he truly was.
Considering he had lost someone precious in an accident, it made sense that he would be afraid.
“I would never leave Maria or you, Young Master. I promise.”
His pain was clear and it made her heart ache. Understanding how deeply he felt, she gently hooked her finger around his, sealing the promise.

127139.synopsis:
【Animal Mind-Reading, Group-Pampered + Sweet & Satisfying】
A useless little junior sister from the Beast-Taming Sect transmigrated into the body of a bankrupt heiress with the same name — Ruan Xingyao. Her father was dead, her mother gone, and her younger brother had become a vegetable lying in a hospital bed.
As the only member of the Ruan family still able to move around, Ruan Xingyao took on the heavy responsibility of earning money to support the family.
Fortunately, she possessed the ability to read animals’ minds and was bound to a system that gave her rewards for protecting furry little ones.
Someone ab*sed a cat? Catch them!
Avenge the cat!
Someone tried to steal a wild giant panda? Catch them!
Not a single one would be spared!
Someone experimented on furry animals and poisoned them? Catch them!
Wipe out their entire lair!
As Ruan Xingyao rescued more and more little animals, she not only paid off her debts but also woke her brother from his coma!
But… what was going on?
The captain of the criminal police, a domineering CEO, a top-tier celebrity, and a renowned research professor… were all lining up at her doorstep!
“Hey! I was just being nice and lending you a little help—there’s no need to repay me with your hand in marriage!”

155299.synopsis:
Transmigrated to a chaotic ancient era, Chen Xiang took on the role of a cold-blooded, ruthless strategist to complete the system’s mission: unifying and pacifying the realm.
He supported a rising warlord to the throne and, in just ten years, put the devastated rivers and mountains back together.
Chen Xiang said, “Efficiency guaranteed!”
Breaking ties with his childhood sweetheart and senior brother, being condemned by the entire world, and being discarded once his usefulness was gone, he didn’t care about any of it.
So what if he died and his entire clan was wiped out? As long as the mission was complete and the world was at peace, that was enough.
Chen Xiang closed his eyes peacefully.
Who would have thought…
[Ding! An issue has been detected with the system task. Host, please redo the mission!] 
The coffin lid was thrown open. Chen Xiang snapped his eyes open.
Wait, what? He had only been dead a few years!
What went wrong with the world he worked so hard to stabilize?!
associated_names: 祸国毒士死后竟成白月光

165795.synopsis:
After waking up from a nap, impoverished wage s*ave Xie Xingchen discovers that he has transmigrated into a novel—as the s*upid and vicious cannon fodder who has nothing but money.
Xie Xingchen: Oh my—nothing but money? There’s actually such a good thing in this world?!
Holding the divorce agreement, Xie Xingchen sorrowfully watches his ex-husband’s departing figure. Only much later does he “reluctantly” open the asset list left behind by the lawyer and, enduring heart-piercing pain… clear out his online shopping cart!
[Ding dong, system activated… The Infrastructure Maniac System welcomes you. The planet you purchased (Earth) has been delivered. Please bind your territory within one week to begin the game!] 
Before he can even celebrate buying Earth, Xie Xingchen looks at the barren, hell-mode wasteland before him. He takes a deep breath, feeling an indescribable ache in his chest.
The once-glorious culture humanity had been proud of is gone.
The Blue Planet, once covered in lush vegetation, has become an abandoned wasteland no one wants.
Recalling Earth’s former beauty and prosperity, Xie Xingchen secretly vows to restore its splendor.
Unexpectedly, he overdoes it a little… and Earth becomes wildly popular across the entire interstellar world?
Reading Guide:
– The male lead is not the ex-husband; no reconciliation after separation.
– The marriage to the ex-husband was purely contractual; both protagonists are “clean.”
– The original novel’s main bottom is not vilified; both characters shine in their own ways.
– Includes elements of infrastructure building, farming, and business simulation.
Tags: Farming fiction, System, Transmigration into a Book, Feel-good/Power Fantasy
Main Character: Xie Xingchen
Previews: Opening a Hotel in a Western Fantasy World, A Homeroom Teacher Never Easily Admits Defeat
Other Keywords: Infrastructure building, farming, simulation management
One-Sentence Summary: I Took Over the Interstellar World Through Infrastructure Building
Theme: Reviving Earth—working hard to rebuild the planet and create a beautiful homeland!
associated_names: 一覺醒來我繼承了地球[星際]
一觉醒来我继承了地球[星际]

201635.synopsis:
“I know you spent the night with my father.”
“Ethan Chantler!”
A faint, mocking smile crossed Ethan’s face.
“Then be with me too.”
“…What?”
“It’s only fair, isn’t it? Why should my father be the only one?”
When Ethan learned that Tersha had spent the night with his father, jealousy consumed him.
“When I heard the news… I wanted to leave everything behind and come to you immediately.”
“Ethan…”
“I couldn’t focus on anything. I couldn’t even look at the documents in front of me.”
“…Lord Kalian.”
“Yes?”
Kalian looked between the two of them with quiet amusement.
“Father, don’t tease Tersha too much.”
“You can’t expect to have her all to yourself forever.”
Caught between father and son, Tersha could only lower her gaze as the two men openly competed for her affection.
Each refused to yield.
Each wanted to claim her heart.
And neither intended to lose.

207267.synopsis:
On the first day gaokao scores came out, a certain Zhuo — just named top science-track scorer in his province — died.
Died, but not all the way.
He woke up in a scholarly old family, also surnamed Zhuo, as the eldest grandson of the senior branch. Six years old.
Sounds good. Except the family patriarch had backed the wrong side in a succession fight and lost his head for it, and his three sons — all promising, all credentialed — were exiled with their whole households to Shuozhou in the far north and sentenced to hard labor.
Zhuo Siheng assumed he’d been handed a survival game, so he set about learning practical survival skills. What he didn’t expect was that a few years later a new emperor would take the throne and declare a general amnesty. The Zhuo family’s convict status could be lifted, but going home was out of the question. Shuozhou is poor, remote and backward, and still needs developing. You’re getting ordinary-citizen status, so stop complaining.
So the boy made up his mind. If he was no longer a criminal’s descendant and could sit the imperial examinations, he’d change his fate by exam and fight his way back.
He had transmigrated straight off the gaokao with his brain at its peak, and all that knowledge came with him. The kitten goes mew mew mew, and everything is marvelous, marvelous, marvelous.
Unfortunately, he was a science student.
In an age when the examinations tested nothing but the humanities, changing his fate meant scaling the heavens.
But even the ninth heaven can be climbed.
Let me scale the sky and seize the Northern Dipper — the heavens are high, and I make myself strong.

213155.synopsis:
Xia Miao transmigrates into another world and, forced by circumstances, enters the online game Gods, becoming a Gold-Farming Player.
Because she is too lazy, she sleeps through the game’s entire launch day, but unexpectedly obtains the Achievement “Drop Dead from Laziness” and the Passive Skill Tenfold Amplification!
Just as she wishes, she no longer even needs to use Skills when playing the game! Then she changes class to Knight, a profession that benefits from taking hits!
Sunfire, Thornmail, and Liandry’s, attacking me is the same as attacking yourself!
Thus begins the invincible and hilarious journey of a lazy Knight!
associated_names: 变身女骑士，被动技能，十倍增幅
